item.title: Book the garden room for a club
item.summary: A club organiser checks what the venue provides.
item.transcript_text:
Nora: I'd like the garden room for our chess group next Thursday. Can we use it from six until eight?
Lee: Six is fine. There will be a dance class at eight, so everyone needs to leave the room by ten to eight.
Nora: That's okay. Do we have to bring tables?
Lee: The tables are there. Bring your own chess sets, though. If you want tea, you can use the kitchen at the end of the hall.

questions.prompt: What is Nora trying to arrange?
options: A trip to a chess shop
A booking for a chess meeting
questions.explanation: She asks to use the garden room for chess.

questions.prompt: When must the group be out?
Why must they leave by then?
questions.explanation: The room must be cleared for the next class.
The group supplies its own chess sets.

options: In the kitchen at the far end of the hall
questions.explanation: Lee says the kitchen is at the end of the hall.
